purpose: Teach: 連合/入手/出場/総務/プレス/出荷/故障/名義

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、連合、絶対、警備、絶対、対応中です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police are handling this with full commitment and care. Thank you for your support.
lines.style: Professional, measured tone. Even pacing. Opens with quiet authority. Reassuring without being performative. The cadence of someone accustomed to delivering official updates.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠品の、本気で、絶対、入手、絶対、警察様、絶対、進められたんですね、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've received the evidence from the police, and we're proceeding as directed. Thank you for your coordination.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive. Slight nod in the voice on the opening 'yes.' Careful enunciation on procedural details. Warm deference without obsequiousness — the tone of a reliable partner.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気で、絶対、合同訓練、絶対、出場、絶対、選手、絶対、決定しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: The police have confirmed participation in the joint training exercise. We've finalized the roster.
lines.style: Direct, matter-of-fact. Crisp delivery on key details. No unnecessary inflection — the efficiency of someone moving through checklist items. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の、本気で、絶対、総務、絶対、部、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご対応、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our administrative department is fully prepared to support the police in whatever way is needed.
lines.style: Earnest commitment. Clear articulation on 'fully prepared.' Slight emphasis on the partnership. Steady pace. The reassurance of someone confirming capacity rather than asking for it.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、本気for、絶対、プレス、絶対、リリース、絶対、慎重に、絶対、対応しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: We're handling the press release with appropriate caution. All statements are being reviewed carefully.
lines.style: Deliberate, controlled tempo. Opens with quiet weight on 'handling.' Each phrase spaced slightly — the measured breathing of someone managing sensitive information. No rush.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。証拠品の、本気で、絶対、出荷、絶対、警察様、絶対、ご対応、絶対、いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The evidence has been catalogued and transferred to the police as required. All procedures completed.
lines.style: Confirmatory tone. Precise enunciation on procedural terms. Even delivery — the voice of someone checking final boxes. Professional closure without abruptness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察車両の、本気で、絶対、故障、絶対、整備、絶対、警察、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Police vehicle maintenance is underway. We're coordinating with the appropriate departments to ensure timely completion.
lines.style: Steady, logistical. Opens cleanly. Methodical pacing through each component. Matter-of-fact about coordination — the voice of someone managing moving parts without stress.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。容疑者の、本気で、絶対、名義、絶対、確認、絶対、警察様、絶対、進められております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The suspect identification is being verified by the police. We're assisting with all necessary cross-checks.
lines.style: Attentive support. Slight lean-in on 'being verified' — engaged but not overstepping. Calm continuity. The tone of a junior partner confirming they're holding their end steady.
